description: How a nested header name — an entry of a top-level `headers` object argument whose served schema is open (`{"type": "object"}`), with the value "v" — is treated. The name is trimmed of what JavaScript's String.prototype.trim() strips, then refused if it is SDK-owned (authorization, x-account-id, user-agent, case-insensitively), then if it is not an RFC 9110 token. A forwarded name is the trimmed one.
